category_description: Settings that initialize sampler and filter the data returned by BackPop simulations

settings.name: n_threads
settings.description: Sets the number of cores to use in multiprocessing
settings.options-preface: Used for parallelization of the sampler calculations. Must use a positive integer. If None, no parallelization used.

options.name: integer values
options.description: Number of cores
For example, this sets the number of cores to 2
Default value (not using multiprocessing)

settings.name: n_eff
settings.description: Minimum effective sample size (see nautilus docs)
settings.options-preface: This determines a minimum sample size that needs to be reached for the sampler to converge. However, this does not mean convergence occurs at ``n_eff``.

options.description: For example, this sets the minimum effective sample size to be 8000

settings.name: n_live
settings.description: Number of live points (see nautilus docs)
settings.options-preface: Boundaries are constructed to encompass these live points.

options.description: For example, this sets the number of live points to be 1000

settings.name: verbose
settings.description: Whether to print verbose output from BackPop and sampler.

options.name: True
options.description: Print verbose output from BackPop and sampler progress.

options.name: False
options.description: Do not print verbose output from Backpop and sampler progress.

settings.name: output_folder
settings.description: Path to save output files. If not supplied, output folder created in directory BackPop is run.

options.name: path/to/output_folder
options.description: This specifies the absolute path to save the output files from BackPop.
Default value (not supplying an output path)

settings.name: resume
settings.description: Resumes sampling from previous run (see nautilus docs)

options.name: True
options.description: Resume sampler from previous run.

options.name: False
options.description: Do not resume sampler from previous run. Restart sampler and rewrite files.

settings.name: phase_condition
settings.description: Determines evolutionary state(s) of interest
settings.options-preface: Can use predefined phases or custom phase to target astrophysical events. See COSMIC output docs for information on evolutionary conventions.

options.name: BH_MS
options.description: For example, this phase selects binaries with a kstar_1 = 14 & kstar_2 = [0,1] or kstar_1 = [0,1] & kstar_2 = 14.
Default does not filter for any condition.

settings.name: use_bcm
settings.description: Saves BCM from Backpop run (see COSMIC BCM docs)

options.name: True
options.description: Saves BCM from BackPop run.

options.name: False
options.description: Does not save BCM from backpop run.

settings.name: bcm_columns
settings.description: Select which columns in the BCM to save
settings.options-preface: Must choose columns that are in COSMIC BCM docs.

options.name: ['tphys', 'kstar_1', 'kstar_2', 'ecc']
options.description: For example, this phase selects binaries with a kstar_1 = 14 & kstar_2 = [0,1] or kstar_1 = [0,1] & kstar_2 = 14.
Default to save all BCM columns if ``use_bcm`` is True.

settings.name: bpp_columns
settings.description: Select which columns in the BPP to save
settings.options-preface: Must choose columns that match the observational constraints given. See COSMIC BPP docs for column names.

options.name: ['mass_1', 'mass_2', 'porb', 'ecc']
options.description: For example, this phase selects binaries with a kstar_1 = 14 & kstar_2 = [0,1] or kstar_1 = [0,1] & kstar_2 = 14.
Default to save all BPP columns.

settings.name: n_bpp_rows
settings.description: Batch size used to label bin_num
settings.options-preface: Should choose a batch size that is large enough to encompass one entire binary evolution.

options.description: For example, this sets the batch size to be 35 lines of the output
Default value is 35 rows

category_description: Observational measurements of an individual binary

settings.name: mean
settings.description: Observed mass of the primary in solar masses

options.description: For example, this sets the mass to 10 Msun
Default value

settings.name: sigma
settings.description: Uncertainity of the observed mass of the primary in solar masses

options.description: For example, this sets the sigma to 2 Msun
Default value

settings.name: out_name
settings.description: Column name used to store the primary mass observable in the output files
settings.options-preface: Must match a column name in the BPP/BCM output (see COSMIC docs).

options.name: mass_1
options.description: For example, this compares the observable against the mass_1 column

settings.name: mean
settings.description: Observed mass of the secondary in solar masses

options.description: For example, this sets the mass to 10 Msun
Default value

settings.name: sigma
settings.description: Uncertainity of the observed mass of the secondary in solar masses

options.description: For example, this sets the sigma to 2 Msun
Default value

settings.name: out_name
settings.description: Column name used to store the secondary mass observable in the output files
settings.options-preface: Must match a column name in the BPP/BCM output (see COSMIC docs).

options.name: mass_2
options.description: For example, this compares the observable against the mass_2 column

settings.name: mean
settings.description: Observed orbital period in days

options.description: For example, this sets the orbital period to 10 days
Default value

settings.name: sigma
settings.description: Uncertainty of the observed orbital period in days

options.description: For example, this sets the sigma to 2 days
Default value

settings.name: out_name
settings.description: Column name used to store the orbital period observable in the output files
settings.options-preface: Must match a column name in the BPP/BCM output (see COSMIC docs).

options.name: porb
options.description: For example, this compares the observable against the porb column

settings.name: mean
settings.description: Observed eccentricity

options.description: For example, this sets the eccentricity to 0.5
Default value

settings.name: sigma
settings.description: Uncertainity of the observed eccentricity

options.description: For example, this sets the sigma to 0.01
Default value

settings.name: out_name
settings.description: Column name used to store the eccentricity observable in the output files
settings.options-preface: Must match a column name in the BPP/BCM output (see COSMIC docs).

options.name: ecc
options.description: For example, this compares the observable against the ecc column

settings.name: metallicity_mode
settings.description: Whether the binary's metallicity is treated as a single fixed value or as an observable to be varied/fit (with a mean and uncertainty), just like the mass, orbital period, and eccentricity observables above.

options.name: fixed
options.description: Metallicity is fixed at a single assumed value.

options.name: variable
options.description: Metallicity is treated as an observable with a mean and sigma, and is sampled/fit like the other observables.

settings.name: value
settings.description: Observed (or assumed) metallicity of the binary, in absolute units (Z). Only used when metallicity is fixed. When using METISSE, the metallicity value must match those of the stellar tracks.

options.description: For example, this sets the metallicity to solar (Z = 0.02)
Default value

settings.name: mean
settings.description: Observed (or assumed) mean metallicity of the binary, in absolute units (Z). Only used when metallicity is variable. When using METISSE, this should fall within the range of the stellar tracks.

options.description: For example, this sets the mean metallicity to solar (Z = 0.02)
Default value

settings.name: sigma
settings.description: Uncertainty on the observed metallicity, in absolute units (Z). Only used when metallicity is variable.

options.description: For example, this sets sigma to 0.002
Default value

settings.name: out_name
settings.description: Column name used to store the metallicity observable in the output files. Only used when metallicity is variable.
settings.options-preface: Must match a column name in the BPP/BCM output (see COSMIC docs).

options.name: met
options.description: Default value, matching the 'met' column

settings.name: value
settings.description: Observed (or assumed) evolutionary time of the binary in Myr

options.description: For example, this sets the evolution time to 10000 Myr
Default value

category_description: The prior boundaries placed on each observable

settings.name: min
settings.description: Minimum allowed value of the primary mass prior, in solar masses

options.description: For example, this sets the minimum primary mass to 5 Msun
Default value

settings.name: max
settings.description: Maximum allowed value of the primary mass prior, in solar masses

options.description: For example, this sets the maximum primary mass to 150 Msun
Default value

settings.name: min
settings.description: Minimum allowed value of the secondary mass prior, in solar masses

options.description: For example, this sets the minimum secondary mass to 0.1 Msun
Default value

settings.name: max
settings.description: Maximum allowed value of the secondary mass prior, in solar masses

options.description: For example, this sets the maximum secondary mass to 150 Msun
Default value

settings.name: min
settings.description: Minimum allowed value of the orbital period prior, in days

options.description: For example, this sets the minimum orbital period to 0.1 days
Default value

settings.name: max
settings.description: Maximum allowed value of the orbital period prior, in days

options.description: For example, this sets the maximum orbital period to 10000 days
Default value

settings.name: min
settings.description: Minimum allowed value of the eccentricity prior

options.description: For example, this sets the minimum eccentricity to 0 (circular)
Default value

settings.name: max
settings.description: Maximum allowed value of the eccentricity prior

options.description: For example, this sets the maximum eccentricity to 1
Default value

settings.settings-section-description: Add additional priors not listed above (e.g., natal kick magnitude and direction). Any additional prior will be included in the generated ini file as [backpop.var::prior_name].

category_description: Settings that control the single star evolution in the simulation

settings.name: stellar_engine
settings.description: Select which stellar evolution engine to use for single star evolution

options.name: sse
options.description: Use SSE for single star evolution which will apply the fitting formulae from Hurley+2000 for the single star evolution

options.name: metisse
options.description: Use METISSE for single star evolution, must supply path_to_tracks and path_to_he_tracks

settings.name: path_to_tracks
settings.description: Path to the METISSE tracks for single star evolution. Must be supplied if stellar_engine is set to metisse

options.name: path/to/tracks
options.description: This specifies the absolute path to the EEP tracks for single star evolution. Leave the string empty if not using METISSE for single star evolution.
Default value (not using METISSE for single star evolution)

settings.name: path_to_he_tracks
settings.description: Path to the METISSE tracks for helium star evolution. Must be supplied if stellar_engine is set to metisse

options.name: path/to/he_tracks
options.description: This specifies the absolute path to the EEP tracks for helium star evolution. Leave the string empty if not using METISSE for single star evolution.
Default value (not using METISSE for single star evolution)

settings.name: z_accuracy_limit
settings.description: Sets the maximum allowed relative difference between the supplied metallicity and the tracks used by METISSE. If cosmic throws an error due to metallicity, increasing this slightly may help. Must be supplied if stellar_engine is set to metisse

options.name: positive values
options.description: Minimum metallicity
Recommended value

settings.name: metisse_verbose
settings.description: Whether to print verbose output from METISSE when using METISSE for single star evolution.

options.name: True
options.description: Print verbose output from METISSE when using METISSE for single star evolution.

options.name: False
options.description: Do not print verbose output from METISSE when using METISSE for single star evolution.
